timelines.title: Savinya–Asmitha Physical Confrontation
timelines.message: Day 23 promos: Lakshmi questions Kumaran's game. Savinya and Asmitha fight; Savinya pushes Asmitha. Six-person rope eviction is still unresolved. Season ongoing; no finale yet.

timelines.title: Rope Task Dynamics Heat Up
timelines.message: Dhanyaa breaks down while tied to Javeed after teasing from Muniyammal, Ansar and Jason. Hotel task follows; Dhanyaa and Mukesh clash. Muniyammal vs Avinash. Savinya and Muniyammal target Asmitha.

timelines.title: Th3 Turning Point Rope Task
timelines.message: Six people enter the danger zone. Bigg Boss says only three of the six will stay. Scissors are placed; anyone can cut the rope and walk out. Open nominations are announced then cancelled; Week 4 has no captain and no Democracy Room.

timelines.title: 3 Contestant Reentry
timelines.message: Evicted housemates Lakshmi Priya, Javeed Sherif and Savinya Velu re-enter. They must each tie a rope to a housemate they think is unfit: Savinya–Asmitha, Lakshmi–Kumaran, Javeed–Dhanyaa.

timelines.title: 3 Eviction-Free Passes
timelines.message: Bigg Boss reveals three one-time eviction-free passes valid until Week 10, raising late-game strategy stakes.

timelines.title: Anandhi Exits After Family Tragedy
timelines.message: Anandhi leaves around Day 20. She was already facing public votes; her father dies of a heart attack and she is sent out urgently. Reports mix public-vote eviction with compassionate/emergency exit.

timelines.title: Lakshmi Priya Evicted
timelines.message: Housemate vote: Lakshmi Priya 7, Anandhi 4, Muthazhagi 3. Lakshmi is 4th out. She criticizes Avinash as a weak captain before leaving.

timelines.title: Spotlight Task
timelines.message: Acting/performance Spotlight task. Worst performers named: Lakshmi Priya, Muthazhagi, Anandhi. They must pitch to stay; housemates vote.

timelines.title: Titles Task and Anandhi Breakdown
timelines.message: Housemates impersonate each other, then assign sarcastic titles (Anandhi tagged Drama Queen). Anandhi is heavily nominated, asks Bigg Boss to open the door, and considers walking.

timelines.title: Kitchen Row and Week 3 Nominations
timelines.message: Ruling vs opposition fight over cleaning and food. Shathiga–Ansar kitchen spat. Nominations include Anandhi, Ansar, Chandini, Dhanyaa, Lakshmi Priya, Muniyammal, Shama; Raaghav gets a direct nomination via star ratings.

timelines.title: Avinash Wins Captaincy
timelines.message: Find the Dinosaur Egg task: Avinash beats Vinoth and Mukesh after housemate voting and team support (Prithivi finds the key). Avinash takes oath in Democracy Room.

timelines.title: Manivannan Public Eviction
timelines.message: Manivannan is evicted after public votes (3rd eviction). Short wildcard stay. Ansar is emotional. Host reviews Cheese House clashes with Shama, Jason, Anandhi and Lakshmi Priya.

timelines.title: Javeed Evicted by Housemates
timelines.message: Javeed is voted out by housemates (2nd eviction). Commoner vs celebrity tension and nomination strategy become central dynamics.

timelines.title: Week 2 Captain Mukesh / Shama
timelines.message: Mukesh and later Shama hold leadership. Mukesh uses an eviction-free pass advantage. Leader Exit List targets include Shama, Asmitha and Javeed.

timelines.title: Cheese House Task
timelines.message: Musical-chairs style Cheese House in the garden: 19 people, shrinking holes. Physical scramble, arguments, and later host grilling over roughness.

timelines.title: Physical Clash During Task
timelines.message: Lakshmi Priya–Anandhi fight escalates during a task; Anandhi is pushed and appears injured. Host later questions both sides.

timelines.title: Anandhi Wildcard Entry
timelines.message: Actress Anandhi Ajay enters on Day 8/9 as second wildcard. She is emotional on arrival and quickly clashes with Lakshmi Priya and others.

timelines.title: First Eviction: Savinya
timelines.message: Leader Exit List after Night Stars: Muniyammal, Dhanyaa, Savinya. Housemates vote Savinya out (first eviction; midweek housemate-decided exit, not public vote).

timelines.title: Captaincy Crisis
timelines.message: Shathiga is targeted in Democracy Question Hour and later steps down. Vinoth assumes leadership. Muniyammal breaks down after jail/punishment.

timelines.title: Manivannan Wildcard Entry
timelines.message: Common Man finalist Manivannan Uppiliappan enters as first wildcard after Pandi's exit. He had been rejected on premiere stage.

timelines.title: Black Pandi Walks Out
timelines.message: Pandi leaves on Day 3 after a health warning. Shock exit; he had been active in kitchen and entertainment.

timelines.title: Shathiga Becomes First Captain
timelines.message: Shathiga wins the first captaincy. Vinoth becomes opposition leader. Democracy Room rules are introduced.

timelines.title: First Tasks and Leadership Battle
timelines.message: Night Stars overnight entertainment task begins. Jananayagam leadership task shortlists Jason, Muthazhagi, Shama, Shathiga and Vinoth. Early kitchen/duty clashes start, including Shathiga vs Muniyammal.

timelines.title: 19 Housemates Enter
timelines.message: Selected lineup: Lakshmi Priya, Shathiga, Prithivinath, Javeed Sherif, Muthazhagi, Asmitha Neelamegam, Avinash Ashok, Pandi (Black Pandi), Vinoth Babu, Chandini Tamilarasan, Savinya Velu, Kumaran Thangarajan, Raaghav Ranganathan, Dhanyaa Pallath, Mukesh, Adavadi Ansar, plus Common Man winners Shama, Muniyammal and Jason.

timelines.title: Live Audience Selection Twist
timelines.message: About 29–30 shortlisted faces pitch live. Studio audience vote immediately. Roughly 10–11 are rejected on stage before entry. First time commoners compete with celebrities.

timelines.title: Season 10 Grand Premiere
timelines.message: Bigg Boss Tamil 10 (Carnivizha) launches on Star Vijay and JioHotstar with host Vijay Sethupathi. Theme is a 10-year carnival. House features a gender-neutral bedroom, captain bedroom, Common Man mural, central courtyard dining table, and a new Democracy Room for leader vs opposition.
